provider: ADTAQ Storage VPS — 2 TB, 30 days free (card-gated)

free_tier.stated: 2 TB HDD (SSD-cached), 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 6 TB/month bandwidth on 1 Gbps — $20/month, FREE for the first month. Paid ladder is $10/TB/month with RAID6 + NVMe cache, up to 4 TB at $40.

egress.terms: 6 TB/month premium bandwidth included at 1 Gbps; beyond that it is metered. Not CF-covered. for a user's 'serve 500 GB–1 TiB/day' workload this is ~6 days of traffic — fails that workload but fits cold archive ingest.

tooling: Root KVM VPS: full SSH/SFTP/rsync, mountable as rclone sftp remote or with rclone mount + fuse. Host rep explicitly runs KVM + VirtFusion.
chaining: One trial per customer (Stripe ties card to VirtFusion provisioning — 'our provisioning solution ties Stripe directly to Virtfusion'). The flow ties each card to one provisioning record, so a second trial needs a second card and this is NOT repeatable at scale.
limits_note: 30-day trial then $20/mo unless cancelled. 6 TB/month egress cap. 2 TB per server; larger trial sizes explicitly refused ('we are not offering free trials for those at this time (nor do we plan to)').
reliability_note: Small Idaho host (Lincoln Freedom Group LLC), Boise datacentre, RAID6. New enough that the soft launch itself was the reliability test; no long-run track record. Trial VPS is deleted if not converted.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: '$20/MONTH FREE for 1 Month'; 'Stripe is going to ask you for your credit card … Your card WILL NOT be charged unless you keep the server past the 30 day trial'
